results.name: the credential authority sees Redis and the coturn admin CLI
a share pair with two individual credentials connects and carries video through the relay
the selected candidate pair is a RELAY candidate (no direct path)
the credentials are distinct per role and opaque (no account, meeting or share id in them)
coturn lists live allocation(s) under the PRESENTER credential, found by username
x1: pair up
X1: a deleted credential can NOT make a new allocation (401, no relay candidate)
x2: pair up
X2: cancelling alone is NOT enough: the client reconnects with the still-valid credential (the ASCS-M1.1 weakness, reproduced with a user-database credential)
two shares (two sets of credentials) are up
revoking share 1 stops share 1 ...
... and does NOT touch share 2 (still flowing, its credentials still allocate)
the registry shows share 1 revoked and terminated, share 2 untouched
x3: pair up (carrying video)
revokeShare reports every credential deleted and every allocation terminated
C3 existing allocation terminated: the relay stops forwarding the screen
coturn no longer lists any allocation of either credential
C2 ICE restart after revocation: the connection does NOT come back (25 s)
C2 the revoked credential is refused for a NEW allocation (presenter and viewer): 401, no relay candidate
a "camera" pair and a "share" pair are up, on different credentials
coturn holds them as SEPARATE allocations (no id in common)
revoking the share leaves the camera pair untouched: after the revoke it keeps at least 70% of its own baseline rate in every 2 s window
and the share pair is dead
issue() re-checks authorization AFTER the credential exists and refuses
... the credential it had written is revoked and terminated at once (a probe confirms it is dead)
r1: two pairs up
coturn restarted and its admin CLI answers again
a credential revoked BEFORE the TURN restart is still refused AFTER it
control: a FRESH credential from the authority allocates normally after the restart (the relay itself works)
an UNREVOKED credential still allocates after the TURN restart (Redis kept the user database): no collateral loss
r2: pair up
the revocation is recorded durably and the credential key is deleted, but termination is reported incomplete
the registry shows the revocation as PENDING termination
reconcile() on the new instance terminates it
the relay stops forwarding after reconcile
and the registry now says terminated
TURN control service (admin CLI) unavailable: NEW screen sharing is denied
credential store (Redis) unavailable: NEW screen sharing is denied
nothing was written to the registry by the denied attempts
r4: short-lived pair up
reconcile() revokes the expired credentials and terminates their allocations
the relay stops forwarding
r5: pair up
after Redis loses its data NO credential allocates (revoked or not): fail closed, clients must be re-authorized
p: relay pair up at 720p
relay carries 720p screen content at about the same frame rate as a direct path (>= 80%)
